results.title: LLM-INSTRUCT at UZH Shared Task 2026: Constraint-Aware Retrieval and Selective Debate for Paragraph-Level Argument Mining
results.snippet: We present LLM-INSTRUCT, the winning system for the UZH Shared Task at ArgMining 2026 on paragraph-level argument mining in UN and UNESCO resolutions. The task requires paragraph-type classification, prediction of a subset of 141 official tags, and directed relation prediction under a strict JSON schema setting using only open-weight models up to 8B parameters. We frame the task as constrained structured prediction. The system first narrows the candidate tag space with metadata-aware dense retrieval, then applies constrained decoding with per-dimension caps, escalates only uncertain cases to…

results.title: Keeping an Eye on AI: A Framework for Effective Human Oversight of AI Systems
results.snippet: The use of Artificial Intelligence (AI) in high-risk, decision-making scenarios presents technical, safety, and normative challenges; problems that may only be ameliorated by human oversight. However, notions of human oversight lack a common foundational understanding: oversight architectures are not well defined, the roles involved remain unclear, and implementation steps are opaque. Hence, researchers and practitioners struggle to determine how to design, implement, and evaluate systems that enable effective human oversight. This paper advances a practical framework for effective human over…

results.title: Knowledge Divergence and the Value of Debate for Scalable Oversight
results.snippet: AI safety via debate and reinforcement learning from AI feedback (RLAIF) are both proposed methods for scalable oversight of advanced AI systems, yet no formal framework relates them or characterizes when debate offers an advantage. We analyze this by parameterizing debate's value through the geometry of knowledge divergence between debating models. Using principal angles between models' representation subspaces, we prove that the debate advantage admits an exact closed form. When models share identical training corpora, debate reduces to RLAIF-like where a single-agent method recovers the sa…

results.title: NTIRE 2026 Challenge on Robust AI-Generated Image Detection in the Wild
results.snippet: This paper presents an overview of the NTIRE 2026 Challenge on Robust AI-Generated Image Detection in the Wild, held in conjunction with the NTIRE workshop at CVPR 2026. The goal of this challenge was to develop detection models capable of distinguishing real images from generated ones in realistic scenarios: the images are often transformed (cropped, resized, compressed, blurred) for practical usage, and therefore, the detection models should be robust to such transformations. The challenge is based on a novel dataset consisting of 108,750 real and 185,750 AI-generated images from 42 generat…

results.snippet: Foundation model developers are among the world's most important companies. As these companies become increasingly consequential, how do their transparency practices evolve? The 2025 FMTI introduces new indicators related to data acquisition, usage data, and monitoring and evaluates companies like Alibaba, DeepSeek, and xAI for the first time. The 2024 FMTI reported that transparency was improving, but the 2025 FMTI finds this prog…

results.title: 360-LLaMA-Factory: Plug & Play Sequence Parallelism for Long Post-Training
results.snippet: Adding sequence parallelism into LLaMA-Factory, we open-sourced 360-LLaMA-Factory at https://github.com/Qihoo360/360-LLaMA-Factory. 360-LLaMA-Factory has received wide recognition and used in models such as Light-R1 arXiv:2503.10460, TinyR1 arXiv:2503.04872, Kaggle AIMO math models and also in large companies' training frameworks. This technical report delves deeper into the different sequence parallel modes behind 360-LLaMA-Factory and discusses our implementation insights.

# 价值对齐与可扩展监督：前沿进展、工程生态与开放争议证据分级报告

**日期**：2026-11-17（UTC）  
**领域**：价值对齐、可扩展监督、校准与不确定性量化  
**检索源数量**：35 条可引用证据（编号 [1]–[2]）

---

## 1. 进展与热点

### 1.1 近 1-2 年核心突破（增量视角）

| # | 进展 | 时间 | 机构/作者 | 热度证据 | 权威证据 | 关注度 | 推荐度 | 说明 |
|---|------|------|-----------|----------|----------|--------|--------|------|
| 1 | **人类监督实用框架** [3] | 2026-05 | 多机构合作（含 HCI/AI 安全学者） | > 待核实（arXiv 预印本，引用数未公开） | arXiv cs.CY 预印本 | 中 — 直接回应可扩展监督架构缺失 | ★★★★☆ — 系统性定义监督架构、角色与实施步骤，填补工程落地空白 | 解决监督架构未定义、角色不清、步骤不透明三大痛点 [3] |
| 2 | **知识发散几何统一辩论与 RLAIF** [4] | 2026-03 | 未标注具体机构 | > 待核实（arXiv 预印本） | arXiv cs.LG 预印本 | 中 — 理论贡献强，针对 scalable oversight 核心机制 | ★★★★☆ — 为辩论机制提供几何视角理论支撑 | 参数化辩论价值，用主角分析知识发散，形式化刻画辩论何时优于 RLAIF [4] |

| 5 | **贝叶斯非负奖励建模缓解 RLHF 奖励黑客** [6] | 2026-02 | 未标注 | > 待核实 | arXiv 预印本 v2 | 中 — 针对 RLHF 核心失效模式 | ★★★★☆ — 从奖励建模层面引入不确定性量化缓解 hacking | 引入贝叶斯非负约束，量化奖励不确定性，抑制过拟合 [6] |
